dialogue.origin: （こんばんわ。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。本日はよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. We will begin at the scheduled time. I look forward to our session today.)

dialogue.origin: （こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. I look forward to it.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんわ。相談員です。まず初めに年齢・性別・本日の相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm the counselor. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: こんばんわ
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: 27歳、女
dialogue.content: 27 years old, female.

dialogue.origin: 趣味がないことに気が付きました…
dialogue.content: I realized I don't have any hobbies...

dialogue.origin: ご相談に来てくださってありがとうございます。そうなんですね。趣味がないことについて相談者さんはどうお思いなのですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in for a consultation. I see. How do you feel about not having any hobbies?

dialogue.origin: 変なのかなって
dialogue.content: I wonder if it's weird.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。そうお感じになられるのですね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. I see that's how you feel.

dialogue.origin: 趣味がないことに気が付いたきっかけはなんだったのですか？
dialogue.content: What was it that made you realize you don't have any hobbies?

dialogue.origin: この前、街コンに行ったんです
dialogue.content: The other day, I went to a matchmaking party.

dialogue.origin: そこでみんな、趣味とか推しとかの話してたんですけど
dialogue.content: And there, everyone was talking about their hobbies or things they're really into...

dialogue.origin: 私別に、特にこれが好きとかなくて
dialogue.content: But for me, there's nothing in particular that I'm that into.

dialogue.origin: みんなの話にはそれなりについて行けたんですけど
dialogue.content: I was able to follow along with everyone's conversations for the most part,

dialogue.origin: あなたは？って聞かれた時に困って
dialogue.content: but when they asked me, "What about you?" I didn't know what to say.

dialogue.origin: ちょっと変な空気になってしまって
dialogue.content: It got a bit awkward.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。街コンに参加したときにそう感じられたのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you felt that way when you attended the matchmaking party.

dialogue.origin: 変な空気になってしまうと戸惑っちゃいますよね。
dialogue.content: It can be unsettling when the atmosphere becomes awkward, can't it?

dialogue.origin: そうでしたｗ
dialogue.content: It was, lol.

dialogue.origin: そういえば履歴書の趣味の欄とかもいつも困ってたなーって思い出して
dialogue.content: Come to think of it, I remembered that I always struggled with the hobbies section on my resume, too.

dialogue.origin: 確かに履歴書のところにも書く欄ありますよね。そういうところにはなにか書いていますか？
dialogue.content: That's true, resumes do have a section for hobbies. What do you usually write there?

dialogue.origin: 最後に履歴書描いたのは就活の時なので
dialogue.content: The last time I filled out a resume was when I was job hunting,

dialogue.origin: もう結構前だけど
dialogue.content: so it was quite a while ago, but

dialogue.origin: Youtubeとか書いたのかな
dialogue.content: I think I wrote something like "watching YouTube."

dialogue.origin: インスタとか
dialogue.content: Or "Instagram."

dialogue.origin: 特に突っ込まれなかった気がします
dialogue.content: I don't think they asked me any follow-up questions about it.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。SNSとか動画は見やすいし趣味に書きやすいですもんね。
dialogue.content: I see. Social media and videos are easy to get into and easy to write down as a hobby, aren't they?

dialogue.origin: 今はお休みの時とかは何をして過ごされているのですか？
dialogue.content: How do you usually spend your time off these days?

dialogue.origin: インスタとかtiktokとか見たり
dialogue.content: I scroll through Instagram and TikTok,

dialogue.origin: アマプラとかネトフリとか
dialogue.content: watch Amazon Prime or Netflix,

dialogue.origin: 犬を飼ってるのでドッグラン行ったり
dialogue.content: take my dog to the dog park,

dialogue.origin: 友だちとランチしたり
dialogue.content: have lunch with friends...

dialogue.origin: 普通です
dialogue.content: just normal stuff.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。結構忙しそうな休日を送っていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like you have quite busy days off.

dialogue.origin: 忙しくはないですｗ
dialogue.content: Not really busy, lol.

dialogue.origin: することないからインスタとかアマプラとか
dialogue.content: I'm on Instagram or Prime because there's nothing else to do,

dialogue.origin: そういう意味ではほとんど何にもしてないですねｗ
dialogue.content: so in that sense, I'm hardly doing anything, haha.

dialogue.origin: 今おっしゃっていただいたことは私が聞く限り趣味なのかなと感じたのですが「趣味」というのは抵抗があるのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: From what you've just told me, it sounds like those could be hobbies, but do you feel some resistance to calling them "hobbies"?

dialogue.origin: ありますあります
dialogue.content: Yes, definitely.

dialogue.origin: 趣味っていうほど知らないっていうか
dialogue.content: It's like, I don't know enough about them to call them a hobby.

dialogue.origin: だってみんなインスタみるしtiktokみるし、なんなら投稿しますよね
dialogue.content: I mean, everyone looks at Instagram and TikTok, and some people even post, right?

dialogue.origin: 私投稿は全然しないで見るだけ
dialogue.content: I don't post at all, I just look.

dialogue.origin: 趣味ってもっとちゃんとしてるイメージ
dialogue.content: I have this image of hobbies being something more proper.

dialogue.origin: 胸張って趣味ですって言えるものがないです
dialogue.content: I don't have anything I can proudly say is my hobby.

dialogue.origin: そうお感じなのですね。例えばどんなことを趣味にしたいとかありますか？
dialogue.content: I see that's how you feel. For example, is there anything you would like to have as a hobby?

dialogue.origin: いやーないですね
dialogue.content: No, not really.

dialogue.origin: あったらやってると思う
dialogue.content: If there were, I think I'd be doing it.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり趣味とか推しってあった方がいいんですかね？
dialogue.content: Is it better to have hobbies or things you're into after all?

dialogue.origin: 確かにそうかもしれませんね。　アマプラなどの動画だと映画やドラマ、アニメなんかの幅広いジャンルがあると思うのですが、そちらは趣味にはなりませんか？
dialogue.content: That may be true. With videos on services like Amazon Prime, there's a wide range of genres like movies, dramas, and anime. Would those not count as hobbies?

dialogue.origin: なります？
dialogue.content: Do they count?

dialogue.origin: 流行りのアニメとかドラマ見てるだけで
dialogue.content: I just watch whatever anime or drama is popular.

dialogue.origin: すいません。メールがかぶってしまいましたね。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, it seems our messages crossed.

dialogue.origin: この声優さんが好きだから、その人がやってるアニメとか海外ドラマとか全部見るとかっていう人がいると
dialogue.content: When there are people who say, 'I love this voice actor, so I watch all the anime and foreign dramas they're in'...

dialogue.origin: ただただオススメに出てくるものとか見てるだけの自分はもう全然
dialogue.content: ...then I, who just watches whatever shows up in my recommendations, feel completely different.

dialogue.origin: ドラマ鑑賞やアニメ鑑賞を趣味にしている方もいるので趣味といえるのかなと思ったのですが
dialogue.content: I thought it could be called a hobby, since there are people whose hobby is watching dramas or anime.

dialogue.origin: なんか、たとえばサイレントとかはやったじゃないですか
dialogue.content: Like, for example, the drama "Silent" was really popular, wasn't it?

dialogue.origin: 見ましたけど、それだけっていうか
dialogue.content: I watched it, but that's it.

dialogue.origin: まあ面白かったから最後まで見ました、終了
dialogue.content: Well, it was interesting so I watched it to the end. The end.

dialogue.origin: サイレント好きな人はすごい細かいことまで覚えてて、何回も見てセリフ言えたりとか
dialogue.content: People who love "Silent" remember all the tiny details, and they can recite the lines from watching it over and over...

dialogue.origin: 聖地巡礼してたりとか
dialogue.content: ...or they go on "pilgrimages" to the filming locations.

dialogue.origin: それはもう趣味っていうか推しなんだろうと思うんですけど
dialogue.content: I think that goes beyond a hobby and into being a 'fan' or 'stan.'

dialogue.origin: 私はただ見て、終わり
dialogue.content: I just watch it, and that's it.

dialogue.origin: それでも趣味って言っていいんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Can I still call that a hobby?

dialogue.origin: サイレント見て手話習い始めましたとか、会社にも何人かいましたけど
dialogue.content: At my company, there were even a few people who started learning sign language after watching "Silent."

dialogue.origin: すごいなって
dialogue.content: I thought that was amazing.

dialogue.origin: そんなことをしている人がいらっしゃるのですね。それはもうドラマ鑑賞の域を超えてサイレント推しの方たちなのかなと思いました。
dialogue.content: So there are people doing things like that. I agree, that seems to go beyond just watching dramas into the realm of being true fans of "Silent."

dialogue.origin: でも、ドラマ鑑賞が趣味ですって言うと、最近の推しはとか、これまでで１番
dialogue.content: But if I say my hobby is watching dramas, people ask things like, 'What's your recent favorite?' or 'What's your all-time number one?'

dialogue.origin: 好きなドラマはとか
dialogue.content: 'What's your favorite drama?'

dialogue.origin: どの俳優が好きかとか
dialogue.content: 'Which actor do you like?'

dialogue.origin: そういう話になって
dialogue.content: The conversation turns to that...

dialogue.origin: いや別にそこまでこだわりないんで…みたいな
dialogue.content: And I'm like, 'Uh, I don't really have strong preferences...'

dialogue.origin: だってドラマ何て誰でも見ますよね
dialogue.content: Besides, everyone watches dramas, don't they?

dialogue.origin: 趣味っていうか普通っていうか
dialogue.content: It feels less like a hobby and more like just a normal thing to do.

dialogue.origin: むしろ１年間に
dialogue.content: In fact, in a year,

dialogue.origin: 1本もドラマ見ませんっていう人の方が珍しいんじゃないかな
dialogue.content: I think it's rarer to find someone who doesn't watch a single drama.

dialogue.origin: どんな理由でも自分の時間を割いてドラマを見ているので趣味といってもいいと思うのですが、相談者さんはそうお感じではないんですね。
dialogue.content: I think you could call it a hobby since you're setting aside your own time to watch dramas for whatever reason, but it seems you don't feel that way.

dialogue.origin: 趣味って言って、そこから話が続かないんです
dialogue.content: If I call it a hobby, the conversation doesn't go anywhere from there.

dialogue.origin: だから言えない
dialogue.content: That's why I can't say it is.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。確かに毎クールドラマをやっているから全く見ない人は少ないかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. That's true. With new dramas coming out every season, there probably aren't many people who don't watch any at all.

dialogue.origin: 趣味がないことに罪悪感を覚えますか？
dialogue.content: Do you feel guilty about not having a hobby?

dialogue.origin: 罪悪感はないです
dialogue.content: I don't feel guilty.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。罪悪感はないけど人と話ができる程度の趣味を持ちたいということですか？
dialogue.content: I see. So you don't feel guilty, but you want to have a hobby that you can talk to people about?

dialogue.origin: いえ
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: 持ちたいというか、ないと変なのかなぁと
dialogue.content: It's not so much that I want one, but more that I wonder if it's strange not to have one.

dialogue.origin: あった方がいいのかなぁと
dialogue.content: and whether it’s better to have one.

dialogue.origin: 仕事のモチベーションになるって言ってる人もいて
dialogue.content: Some people say it motivates them for work.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そうお感じになられるんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So that's how you feel.

dialogue.origin: 趣味とか推しにお金かかるけど
dialogue.content: Hobbies and things you're a fan of cost money, but

dialogue.origin: 趣味とか推しにお金かけるために仕事する、みたいな
dialogue.content: they work in order to spend money on their hobbies and favorite things.

dialogue.origin: それはそうかもしれないとは思いましたけど
dialogue.content: I thought that might be true,

dialogue.origin: 本末転倒な気もするし
dialogue.content: but it also feels like putting the cart before the horse.

dialogue.origin: もうあんな空気になるの嫌だから、街コンにも行けないしｗ
dialogue.content: And I don't want to be in that kind of awkward atmosphere again, so I can't even go to matchmaking parties anymore, lol.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。確かにそうやって仕事のモチベーションにしている人もいらっしゃいますよね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. It's true that some people do use their hobbies that way to motivate them for work.

dialogue.origin: 変な空気になるのはできるだけ避けたいですものね。
dialogue.content: And you want to avoid that awkward atmosphere as much as possible.

dialogue.origin: そうですねー
dialogue.content: Yeah...

dialogue.origin: 街コンとかだと趣味とかからしか話のきっかけないから
dialogue.content: At places like matchmaking parties, hobbies are often the only way to start a conversation,

dialogue.origin: 前からの友だちとか会社の同僚となら気にならないけど
dialogue.content: I don't mind it with my existing friends or colleagues at work, but...

dialogue.origin: あ
dialogue.content: Oh.

dialogue.origin: ここではめっちゃおしゃべりしてますけど実は私
dialogue.content: I'm talking a lot here, but actually,

dialogue.origin: 人見知りなんですｗ
dialogue.content: I'm shy around new people, lol.

dialogue.origin: 人見知りな上に趣味推しないってもう、会話する気ないだろっていう
dialogue.content: Being shy on top of not having hobbies or things I'm into... it must seem like I have no intention of making conversation.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。文章を見ていた限り人見知りを感じなかったので驚きました。
dialogue.content: I see. I'm surprised, as I didn't get the impression that you were shy from your writing.

dialogue.origin: テキストならいくらでも話せますｗ
dialogue.content: I can talk endlessly over text, lol.

dialogue.origin: ここでたくさんお話していただいてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing so much with me here.

dialogue.origin: だから街コン行くのは結構な勇気だったんですけど
dialogue.content: So it took quite a bit of courage for me to go to that matchmaking party,

dialogue.origin: ダメでしたねーｗ
dialogue.content: but it was a bust, lol.

dialogue.origin: 人見知りなのに街コンに行くのは相当な勇気でしたね。
dialogue.content: Going to a matchmaking party when you're shy must have taken a lot of courage.

dialogue.origin: 今のお話を聴いていて、私が思うに趣味があってもなくてもいいと思います。
dialogue.content: Listening to you now, I think it's perfectly fine whether you have hobbies or not.

dialogue.origin: 趣味がないからこそ人におすすめなどを聞いてそこから話を広げることとかはいかがですか？
dialogue.content: Precisely because you don't have a hobby, how about asking people for their recommendations and expanding the conversation from there?

dialogue.origin: おすすめの趣味あります？みたいなことですか？
dialogue.content: You mean like, 'Do you have any hobbies you'd recommend?'

dialogue.origin: そうです。
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.origin: そうですねー
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: すすめられても困りますけどｗ
dialogue.content: Though I'd be at a loss if they actually recommended one, lol.

dialogue.origin: それか相手の趣味の話から自分の気になるところをきいてみるとか。
dialogue.content: Or perhaps you could listen to the other person talk about their hobby and ask about the parts that catch your interest.

dialogue.origin: その人の趣味を布教されるってことは、その話を延々とされるってことですよね
dialogue.content: If they start evangelizing their hobby, that means they’ll talk about it endlessly, right?

dialogue.origin: キツそうｗ
dialogue.content: That sounds tough, lol.

dialogue.origin: あ、そういうのはしてますよ
dialogue.content: Oh, I do that kind of thing.

dialogue.origin: 流行りものの情報は一通り入ってるので、話にはついて行けるんです
dialogue.content: I'm generally up-to-date on what's popular, so I can follow the conversation.

dialogue.origin: でも自分が興味のない趣味の話って深くなると正直面倒ですよね
dialogue.content: But honestly, when the conversation gets deep about a hobby I'm not interested in, it becomes a pain.

dialogue.origin: 確かに自分に興味のない話だとしんどくなってしまうのであくまで自分の興味のある話だけに焦点を当てるのも難しいですかね？
dialogue.content: It's true that a conversation you're not interested in can be tiring. Would it be difficult to focus only on the parts that do interest you?

dialogue.origin: 自分はもちろんできますけど、質問がうっかり核心をついてしまうと、相手が調子に乗っちゃうこともあるというか
dialogue.content: I can do that, of course, but sometimes if my question accidentally hits on a key point, the other person gets carried away.

dialogue.origin: それなら自分でも趣味とか推しとかひとつでもあれば予防線張れるかなと思ったんですけど
dialogue.content: I thought that if I had even one hobby or something I was into, I could use it as a sort of defense mechanism.

dialogue.origin: そういうもんじゃないんですかねー
dialogue.content: I guess it doesn't work that way, huh?

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そういった意味でも趣味を見つけたいということだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So that was another reason you wanted to find a hobby.

dialogue.origin: そうみたいですｗ
dialogue.content: Apparently so, lol.

dialogue.origin: 自分でも今知りましたｗ
dialogue.content: I just realized that myself, lol.

dialogue.origin: 新しい発見ができましたね。
dialogue.content: You've made a new discovery about yourself.

dialogue.origin: そうですかね
dialogue.content: You think so?

dialogue.origin: 意味なさそうですけどｗ
dialogue.content: Seems kind of meaningless, though, lol.

dialogue.origin: 意味なくはないと思いますよ。予防線を張りたいから自分の趣味を探してると分かっただけで前進かと思います。
dialogue.content: I don't think it's meaningless at all. Just understanding that you're looking for a hobby because you want a 'defense mechanism' is a step forward, I believe.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか？
dialogue.content: Is that so?

dialogue.origin: はい。自分のことを知れただけでもいいと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes. I think it's good just to have learned something new about yourself.

dialogue.origin: そうですかね
dialogue.content: I guess so.

dialogue.origin: 何か変わります？
dialogue.content: Will anything change?

dialogue.origin: 自分を知っているのと知らないのでは違ってくると思います。
dialogue.content: I believe there's a difference between knowing yourself and not knowing yourself.

dialogue.origin: 申し訳ありません。そろそろ相談終了のお時間なので、また改めて相談していただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I'm very sorry, but our time for today's session is almost up. Would it be all right if we schedule another consultation?

dialogue.origin: あはい
dialogue.content: Oh, yes.

dialogue.origin: 今回のお話の続きもできますので、また相談にいらしてください。
dialogue.content: We can continue our conversation then, so please feel free to come back for another session.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 本日は色んなお話を聴かせていただきありがとうございました。それでは失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing so much with me today. I'll sign off now.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （本日はありがとうございました。お手隙に評価を頂けたら幸いです。終了させていただきます。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for today. If you have a moment, we would appreciate your feedback. This session is now concluded. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

topic.sub: 趣味がないことによる人間関係の不安
